title: momentum_tracked row
description: Logical row for table momentum_tracked (see shared/databases/migrations/007_momentum.sql). MOMENTUM_SCANNER_PHASE1.md §5 — sell-side state. The original brief specified sell channels but never defined a sell signal; Phase 1 defines it as EXIT TRACKING ON PRIOR ALERTS, not shorting. Buy and sell are not symmetric: a sell signal requires knowing what was previously alerted. The *_at_alert fields are frozen snapshots of the levels the exit rules are measured against and must never be refreshed. These exit rules are a starting default, not a validated strategy — they are deliberately mechanical so the backtest can evaluate and replace them. Nothing here is trading advice; the score is a research output.

alerted_ts.description: The momentum_features.ts that triggered the buy alert

reference_price.description: close[t] at alert; the stop_atr basis

resistance_20_at_alert.description: The level it broke out over; the breakout_failed test compares close[t] against this frozen value

atr_14_at_alert.description: Frozen ATR for the stop_atr test: close[t] < reference_price - 2 * atr_14_at_alert

highest_close_since.description: Highest close since the alert; the timeout rule requires no new high since alert

max_gain_pct.description: Realised maximum favourable move while active. Free labelling data that doubles as a live measure of whether the score is worth anything

low_rvol_streak.description: Consecutive sessions with rvol_20 < 1.5; momentum_stalled fires at 3

sessions_elapsed.description: Trading sessions since the alert; timeout fires at 20

exit_reason.description: Evaluated in exactly this order; the FIRST condition that matches wins (§5)
